Sentences:
1. When a bill in Entered has a total above zero and no lines off, move it to Matched.
2. When a bill in Entered has lines off, it waits on Lena to confirm the match or decline it, into Match review; she notes why in Match note.
3. When Match review is Confirmed, move the bill to Matched.
4. When Match review is Declined, move the bill to Rejected.
5. When a bill enters Matched and its total is over $2,000, it waits on Krishna to approve or decline it, into Approval.
6. When Approval is Approved, move the bill to Approved.
7. When Approval is Declined, move the bill to Rejected.
8. When a bill enters Matched and its total is $2,000 or less, tell Lena it is ready to pay.
9. When a bill is Paid, move its purchase to Billed.
